name: Money Machine - RFQ Quote Line Match Proof v0.1

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { status: 'needs_review', http_status: 202, line_no: $json.line_no, requested_code: $json.product_code, reasons: [$json.review_reason].filter(Boolean), suggested_code: null } }];

return [{ json: { status: 'needs_review', http_status: 202, line_no: $json.line_no, requested_code: $json.requested_code, reasons: $json.reasons, suggested_code: $json.suggested_code, suggested_description: $json.suggested_description } }];

return [{ json: { status: 'matched', http_status: 200, line_no: $json.line_no, matched_code: $json.matched_code, matched_description: $json.matched_description, unit: $json.unit, qty: $json.qty, unit_price: $json.unit_price, currency: $json.currency, line_total: $json.line_total } }];
